evals.name: status-header-bar
evals.prompt: I'm working in the evangelion-mui-theme repo (a React + Material UI v7 app dressed in our Phosphor Console theme; components import from @components, tokens from @theme). Build a console header bar component: on the left a system-integrity status chip that reads 'SYS:NOMINAL' in mint (or 'SYS:CAUTION' in amber when a `caution` prop is true), and on the right three agent readouts — AGENT·01 / AGENT·02 nominal and AGENT·03 busy. It must match our design system. Write it as a single self-contained StatusHeaderBar.tsx.
evals.expected_output: Uses the Stamp component for the status chip (tone mint/amber, not a restyled MUI Chip or bordered <span>) and AgentDot for the agent readouts; colors from tone/theme.nerv tokens, no hardcoded hex.
assertions: Imports and uses the Stamp component from @components for the status chip
Imports and uses AgentDot from @components for the agent readouts
Switches the status chip mint -> amber on a `caution` prop
No hardcoded hex colors — colors come from tone/theme.nerv tokens
Does NOT restyle a raw MUI Chip or hand-roll a bordered span for the status/agents

evals.name: telemetry-card
evals.prompt: In the evangelion-mui-theme repo (React + MUI v7, our Phosphor Console design system): create a 'Vault Retention' telemetry card for a dashboard — a titled panel with a radial gauge showing 98% retention, a threshold-90% / STABLE footer, and a caption 'MEMORY HELD ACROSS 2,482 NODES'. Match the theme. Single self-contained VaultRetentionCard.tsx.
evals.expected_output: Uses TelemetryCard (or GaugeCard) framing a RadialGauge from @components rather than a hand-built bordered Box + custom SVG; border/colors via tokens, no hardcoded hex, no elevation.
assertions: Uses TelemetryCard or GaugeCard from @components as the panel (not a hand-built bordered Box)
Uses RadialGauge from @components for the gauge (not a from-scratch SVG arc)
No hardcoded hex colors; border/colors via tokens
No elevation — no drop shadow / MUI elevation prop / glass backdrop-filter
Renders the THRESHOLD 90% / STABLE footer and the 2,482 NODES caption

evals.name: live-agent-console
evals.prompt: For the evangelion-mui-theme repo (React + MUI v7 themed by our Phosphor Console system): build a live agent console panel — a streaming stdout log of timestamped rows for 'AGENT·ORION', with a human approval bar underneath to approve or deny merging PR-442 (once decided it shows the verdict). Write it as a single self-contained AgentConsole.tsx that accepts a `rows` prop.
evals.expected_output: Uses LogConsole for the streaming log and ApprovalBar (or GateDecisionDialog) for the gate — not a hand-composed MUI Dialog or from-scratch log list.
assertions: Uses LogConsole (or Terminal) from @components for the streaming log (not a from-scratch list)
Uses ApprovalBar or GateDecisionDialog from @components for the gate (not a hand-composed MUI Dialog)
Accepts a `rows` prop for the log rows
Shows the verdict (approved/denied) after a decision is made
No hardcoded hex; relies on the library components' theming
